result.title: Flash RNN-T: Memory-Efficient Joint Network and Transducer Loss Computation
result.summary: The recurrent neural network transducer (RNN-T) remains a practical choice for streaming speech recognition, but training requires large intermediate tensors. We present Flash RNN-T, a joint and loss implementation combining specialized kernels with optional tiled recomputation over the full alignment space and vocabulary. Tiled and untiled Flash form the entire measured throughput-memory frontier on medium and long workloads. On H100, untiled Flash achieves 24-39% higher throughput with 26-56% less memory than the fastest baseline on these workloads wherever it fits. Tiling reduces memory further through recomputation. On medium, tiled Flash uses ninefold less memory than that baseline at 16% lower throughput when both use one backward call per batch. On long, it fits where all tested alternatives with that backward schedule run out of memory with 80 GB. These comparisons use each implementation's lowest-memory configuration reaching at least 95% of its peak throughput.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Flash RNN-T，用专用 kernel 与可选分块重计算降低 RNN-T 联合网络与损失计算训练时的显存占用，并在吞吐-显存前沿上做对比。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于语音转导器的训练显存/吞吐工程优化，未涉及视觉证据、latent 推理状态或停止决策，分块重计算虽与状态更新有字面相似，但无具体可核查的 LVR 借鉴线索。
